episodes.title: Horse Trainer Charged With Murdering Showjumper In Her Own Home
episodes.description:
Contains strong language and discussions of suicide.

When a talented showjumper is found hanging from her staircase at home, the police class it as suicide. But one detective is not convinced.

Evidence mounts against Jonathan Creswell and he's charged with Katie's murder. But as the trial begins, he takes a drastic step that ensures he'll never face justice. (EP2 of 2)

episodes.title: 21 Year-Old Showjumper Found Dead In Her Home In Northern Ireland
episodes.description:
Contains strong language and discussions of suicide.

When a talented showjumper is found hanging from her staircase at home, the police class it as suicide. But one detective is not convinced.

Katie Simpson, a talented showjumper from Northern Ireland, is found hanging from her staircase at home by her sister's boyfriend, Jonathan. Was it really suicide? (EP1 of 2).
